title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative: The Multisectoral Emergency Response & Resilience Building of IDP and Host Communities in Gogrial East and Tonj North Counties, Warrap State programme implemented by Trócaire aims to contribute to Outcome 4.2: The most vulnerable/marginalised women, men, girls and boys in the communities affected by crisis can meet their basic needs. The activities and objective include, Conflict analyses undertaken, community-based peace committees established and trained and Community peace initiatives supported so, communities in conflict affected areas have increased capacity for conflict resolution and promoting peaceful coexistence. Programmes are in partnership with, The Organization for Children's Harmony (TOCH) ---- The principal focus of this objective is:- Establish new systems & structures through which groups, communities or people can lead the response through an active and influential role in shaping decisions that affect their lives- Reduce social, economic or political power inequalities between women and men, girls and boys- Compensate for past discrimination
